Theme

Latin word

super

preposition with the accusative

on top of, onto, over; over, above, across the top of

In this lexicon

  • on top of

    the recommended word · classical · Caes. BC 2.10: super laterēs coria indūcuntur (Lewis & Short); Liv. 21.35.12: aliīque super aliōs

  • over

    the recommended word · classical · Liv. 21.28.1: quatientēs scūta super capita; Liv. 1.4.4: super rīpās Tiberis effūsus

  • super + abl.: about

    classical

  • super crāticulam assāre: grill

    modern

Examples

  • aliīque super aliōs et jūmenta in hominēs occiderent

    and they fell on top of one another, and the pack animals onto the menLiv. 21.35.12

    In the entry for on top of

    the Gauls ran up on the bank with all kinds of howling and their customary chant, shaking their shields over their headsLiv. 21.28.1
